description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Fire with Stacking] depending on entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], and [Crystal Force Mode: Firion]

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: One single attack (10.00) capped at 199,999, grants [Damage Cap +20000 1], [Holy/Fire Ability Quick Cast 1], [Holy/Fire Ability +50% Boost 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1] and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: One single attack (10.00) capped at 199,999, grants [Damage Cap +20000 1], [Holy/Fire Ability Quick Cast 1], [Holy/Fire Ability +50% Boost 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1] and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
